_meta.title: Elemental Relational Taxonomy — the near scales
_meta.role: The relational track of the relay. Same shape as taxonomy.json (3 sub-domains × 3 facets × 3 stances per element) and the same operator algebra, but the facets are written at the scale a person actually lives at: alone, with one other, inside a small group. Selected by SCOPE at the start of a relay — 'just me', 'me and one other', 'a team or group' land here; the organisational and planetary scopes stay on the strategic (PESTLE) track.
_meta.why: The operators are scale-invariant — distinction, coupling, direction, branching, metabolism, boundary read the same at every scale. The facets are not. The strategic taxonomy is a macro-environmental scan (PESTLE); asked to serve a couple or a household it offers 'digital tribes' and 'planetary governance'. This track supplies the missing register rather than rebuilding the algebra.
_meta.voice: Grounded in the Accounts, which are already six-element readings at this scale — σ(the_installed_frame), ρ(two_griefs_no_shared_shape), δγ(the_load_uncomposted). Those are instances; these are the types they are instances of.
_meta.phi_form: <operator>(<facet-slug> | <stance>) — identical to the strategic track, so chains, handoffs and the Sunday synthesis read across both
_meta.third_branch_rule: As in the strategic track, each element's third sub-domain looks forward and its final facet names that element's characteristic capture — the peril stance has something specific to bite on.

stances.cosmology_note: all six neme-dimensions still live; the operator is needed but not yet captured

stances.label: Possibility

elements.strategy: Noticing, Framing & What Is Actually Here
elements.lens_question: What is actually here, before the story about it?

diagnostic.leads_when: the account of it has run ahead of the thing itself — you can say what it means before you can say what happened
diagnostic.blindness: mistakes a clean description for the whole of it; cannot feel what the distinction costs
capture_risk: naming a thing to be done with it
handoff_signs: you can describe it precisely and still cannot move
diagnostic.live_question: What would you have to admit is here, if no one needed you to have a position on it?

stance_frames.pressure: The story has outrun the fact — what is here has to be separated from what was said about it.
stance_frames.possibility: A distinction that clears the air without settling the matter — then hand the clarity on.
stance_frames.peril: The description hardening into the thing: knowing about it instead of meeting it.

facets.text: The fact, and the story laid over it
A frame you were handed and never checked
A mood being read as a verdict
Something changed and has not been named
Knowing it only through what others have said
Standing too close to make out the shape
A future rehearsed so often it feels already known
The question underneath the one being asked
Risks: deciding before looking, certainty as relief

elements.lens_question: What does this touch, and who is holding it with you?

diagnostic.core_question: What does this touch, and who holds it with you?
diagnostic.leads_when: the difficulty is not in the facts but in what is owed, felt, or unsaid between people
diagnostic.blindness: mistakes resonance for truth; cannot tell closeness from agreement
capture_risk: keeping the peace instead of the relationship
handoff_signs: everyone feels understood and nothing changes
closeness is being used to avoid a decision
diagnostic.live_question: What is true here that closeness has made hard to say?

stance_frames.pressure: The bond is carrying more than it can say — what is owed between you needs naming.
stance_frames.possibility: A feeling that widens the relationship instead of narrowing it — coherence that can hold disagreement.
stance_frames.peril: Resonance mistaken for truth: merging, rescuing, belonging that quietly requires your silence.

facets.text: Whose need is quietly shaping this
Trust owed in two directions at once
Belonging that is moving, thinning, or being left
Two feelings that cannot find one shape
The quiet that has grown between people
Warmth that arrives with a request inside it
Something new beginning to resonate
A repair that is still available
Risks: merging, rescuing, peace kept at your expense

elements.lens_question: Where is this heading, and what would you spend for it?

diagnostic.core_question: Where is this heading, and what would it cost?
diagnostic.leads_when: the answer is already known and unacted on — the crossing is being circled rather than made
diagnostic.blindness: mistakes intensity for direction; cannot see what the push costs the people carrying it
handoff_signs: the push has outlived its reason
movement continues and no one can say toward what
diagnostic.live_question: What are you actually prepared to spend, and on what?

stance_frames.pressure: It drifts — the crossing is known and unmade; direction has to become real.
stance_frames.possibility: A direction worth committing to — one that opens movement instead of closing it.
stance_frames.peril: Urgency becoming identity: burning through what the crossing was for.

facets.text: A crossing you have not named out loud
An answer already known and not acted on
What you would actually spend for this
A cost disguised as an open question
Momentum that belongs to someone else
Moving now, or moving when it is ready
A life or a work you keep not lighting
A commitment that would organise the rest
Risks: urgency as identity, burning what you needed

elements.lens_question: What is trying to grow here, and what would give it room?

diagnostic.core_question: What is trying to grow here?
diagnostic.leads_when: the shape has been decided too early — options closed before they were understood
diagnostic.blindness: mistakes possibility for progress; keeps everything open and lands nothing
handoff_signs: options multiply and none is taken
the new thing never has to survive contact
diagnostic.live_question: What would have to be given up for the living part of this to grow?

stance_frames.pressure: It narrowed too early — a form is being forced before it was understood.
stance_frames.possibility: A new form trying to emerge — branches opened before selection closes them.
stance_frames.peril: Branching without rooting: possibility as avoidance, novelty standing in for depth.

facets.text: Something growing that no one planted
The form the thing keeps insisting on
A part of you grown in someone else's shade
A fork that has not been admitted yet
An option worth holding open a while longer
A bond continuing without its original root
A version of this you have not tried
What would have to be cut for the rest to grow
Risks: endless branching, keeping options instead of living one

elements.lens_question: What are you carrying, and what would actually feed it?

diagnostic.core_question: What are you carrying, and what would feed it?
diagnostic.leads_when: the cost has been accumulating quietly — tiredness is arriving as information
diagnostic.blindness: mistakes endurance for capacity; counts what is spent and not what is fed
capture_risk: rest deferred until it is a crisis
handoff_signs: capacity is being borrowed from tomorrow
the load is named and still not put down
diagnostic.live_question: What here can actually be metabolised, and what has simply ended?

stance_frames.pressure: It costs more than it returns — the load has not broken down and is being carried anyway.
stance_frames.possibility: What can be fed, held, or let go so this keeps living.
stance_frames.peril: Endurance as identity: reserve spent as though it were income, care collapsing quietly.

facets.text: A load that has not broken down
A person or an ending not yet metabolised
Strength spent holding something back
What your actual capacity is right now
Work or care that only takes and never feeds
Care being given without being counted
Soil being built slowly and invisibly
Tiredness that is information, not weakness
Risks: running on reserve, care collapse, rest deferred to crisis

elements.lens_question: What holds this, and what has to end for it to keep its shape?

diagnostic.core_question: What holds this, and what should end?
diagnostic.leads_when: the edge has gone soft — what you will and will not allow has stopped being legible, including to you
diagnostic.blindness: mistakes a wall for a boundary; cannot tell integrity from refusal
handoff_signs: the line is held and the relationship is not
diagnostic.live_question: What edge would let this keep its shape without sealing it?

stance_frames.pressure: The edge has gone soft — what is admissible here has stopped being clear.
stance_frames.possibility: A boundary that protects the living part without becoming a wall — form that still breathes.
stance_frames.peril: The wall standing in for the edge: standards that forbid repair, principle as distance.

facets.text: A no that was never actually said
An edge quietly conceded
A standard that forbids wanting anything
A yes that became the measure of you
A line worth keeping even at cost
What you will and will not let through
An ending that has not been marked
The edge a grief or a change requires
Risks: boundary as wall, standards that forbid repair
